description: Quality Gate Rules Template - Customize for your project
_readme: REPLACE the entry in requiredScripts below with the npm script in YOUR
package.json that writes the coverage report -- the one that passes
--coverage. A template cannot know its name, and getting it wrong is not a
cosmetic mistake: the gate reads coverage/coverage-summary.json AFTER running
requiredScripts, so if none of those scripts rewrites that report, the floors
below are graded against whatever generation of the code last wrote it --
silently. The gate does not check a report's age; nothing warns you.
For vitest and jest, the default `test` script writes NO coverage report:
measured with vitest 4 + @vitest/coverage-v8, `npm run test` on `vitest run`
created no coverage/ directory at all, while `vitest run --coverage` did.
Easier alternative: run `npx quality-gate-sgd init`, which picks a
coverage-writing script for you and calibrates these numbers from your
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the gate; delete this one once read.
